description: Figure 5 is a bar chart titled “The average likes of headlines from different season groups.” The vertical y-axis is labeled “Avg Like #” and ranges from 400 to 600, with major tick marks at 400, 450, 500, 550, and 600. The horizontal x-axis is labeled “Most similar group of posts” and displays six categories representing time intervals in days: “(0,90]”, “(90,180]”, “(180,270]”, “(270,360]”, “(360,450]”, and a final unlabeled bar that appears to correspond to the next interval. Each category is represented by a single light blue vertical bar with a black error bar extending above and below it, indicating standard deviation. The bar for the “(0,90]” group reaches approximately 600 likes, the “(90,180]” group is around 570, “(180,270]” is about 550, “(270,360]” is roughly 580, and “(360,450]” is approximately 590. The final bar, corresponding to the last interval, is slightly above 590. The chart visually suggests that headlines from the most recent season (0–90 days) receive the highest average likes, with slight fluctuations in subsequent periods.
